name: Spyro Vita
author: ShayVD
description:
A native PlayStation Vita port of Spyro the Dragon (1998, PlayStation, USA release SCUS-94228).
This is not an emulator. The game's own code, from the TheMobyCollective/spyro-1 decompilation, is compiled for the Vita's ARM CPU. PsyCross stands in for Sony's PlayStation libraries, and the PS1's graphics are drawn by the Vita's GPU (vitaGL).
